begin

    select
        c.id,
        c.subject,
        c.grade,
        c.content,
        1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
    from curriculum_chunks c
    where
        (subject_filter is null or c.subject = subject_filter)

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        cc.id,
        cc.chunk_id,
        cc.content,
        cc.chunk_index,
        cc.metadata,
        ts_rank(
            to_tsvector('english', cc.content),
            plainto_tsquery('english', search_query)
        ) AS rank
    FROM curriculum_chunks cc
    WHERE to_tsvector('english', cc.content) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', search_query)
    ORDER BY rank DESC
    LIMIT limit_count;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH subject_thetas AS (
        SELECT 
            subject,
            MAX(theta) AS max_theta
        FROM quiz_attempts
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id
        GROUP BY subject
        ORDER BY MAX(theta) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    SELECT 
        cp.title,
        cp.title_bn,
        cp.description,
        cp.description_bn,
        cp.icon,
        cp.color,
        st.subject,
        st.max_theta,
        cp.suggested_topics
    FROM subject_thetas st
    CROSS JOIN career_pathways cp
    WHERE st.subject = ANY(cp.required_subjects)
    LIMIT 1;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(MAX(qa.theta), 0.0) AS theta,
        MAX(qa.created_at) AS last_attempt_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_attempts,
        ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN qa.score >= 50 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS success_rate
    FROM quiz_attempts qa
    WHERE qa.user_id = p_user_id AND qa.subject = p_subject;
END;

BEGIN
    -- First, calculate and store predictions
    INSERT INTO exam_predictions (subject, topic, probability, recommendation, year)
    SELECT 
        p_subject,
        t.topic,
        calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, t.topic, p_year) AS prob,
        CASE 
            WHEN calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, t.topic, p_year) > 0.75 THEN 'Must Read - High probability'
            WHEN calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, t.topic, p_year) > 0.5 THEN 'Important - Likely to appear'
            ELSE 'Review if time permits'
        END AS recommendation,
        p_year
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM exam_question_data WHERE subject = p_subject) t
    ON CONFLICT (subject, topic, year) DO UPDATE
    SET probability = EXCLUDED.probability,
        recommendation = EXCLUDED.recommendation;
    
    -- Return top predictions
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        ep.topic,
        ep.probability,
        ep.recommendation,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ep.probability DESC)::INTEGER AS rank
    FROM exam_predictions ep
    WHERE ep.subject = p_subject AND ep.year = p_year
    ORDER BY ep.probability DESC
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT eqd.topic,
        calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, eqd.topic, 2025) AS priority
    FROM exam_question_data eqd
    WHERE eqd.subject = p_subject
    ORDER BY priority DESC
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;

BEGIN
    -- Clear old predictions for this subject/year
    DELETE FROM exam_predictions 
    WHERE subject = p_subject AND year = p_year;
    
    -- Insert new predictions
    INSERT INTO exam_predictions (subject, topic, probability, recommendation, year)
    SELECT 
        p_subject,
        eqd.topic,
        calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, eqd.topic, p_year)::NUMERIC,
        CASE 
            WHEN calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, eqd.topic, p_year) > 0.75 THEN 'Must Read - High probability'
            WHEN calculate_exam_priority(p_subject, eqd.topic, p_year) > 0.5 THEN 'Important - Likely to appear'
            ELSE 'Review if time permits'
        END,
        p_year
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM exam_question_data WHERE subject = p_subject) eqd;
    
    -- Return results with proper casting
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        ep.topic::TEXT,
        ep.probability::NUMERIC,
        ep.recommendation::TEXT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ep.probability DESC)::INTEGER
    FROM exam_predictions ep
    WHERE ep.subject = p_subject AND ep.year = p_year
    ORDER BY ep.probability DESC
    LIMIT p_limit;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH all_topics AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM exam_predictions WHERE subject = p_subject
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM topic_prerequisites WHERE subject = p_subject
    ),
    topic_priorities AS (
        SELECT 
            at.topic,
            COALESCE(ep.probability, 0.5) AS exam_priority,
            COALESCE(get_knowledge_gap_score(p_user_id, p_subject, at.topic), 0) AS knowledge_gap,
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts qa
                WHERE qa.user_id = p_user_id 
                    AND qa.subject = p_subject
                    AND qa.topic ILIKE '%' || at.topic || '%'
                    AND qa.score >= 70
            ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS mastered
        FROM all_topics at
        LEFT JOIN exam_predictions ep ON ep.subject = p_subject AND ep.topic = at.topic
    )
    SELECT 
        tp.topic,
        tp.mastered,
        ROUND((tp.exam_priority * 0.6 + (1 - tp.knowledge_gap) * 0.4) * 100, 2) AS priority_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN tp.mastered THEN 'Already mastered ✓'
            WHEN tp.knowledge_gap < 0.5 THEN 'Complete prerequisites first'
            WHEN tp.exam_priority > 0.75 THEN 'High priority - Study soon'
            WHEN tp.exam_priority > 0.5 THEN 'Medium priority'
            ELSE 'Low priority'
        END AS recommendation
    FROM topic_priorities tp
    ORDER BY tp.mastered ASC, priority_score DESC;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE prereq_tree AS (
        -- Base case: direct prerequisites
        SELECT 
            tp.prerequisite_topic AS prereq_topic,
            1 AS depth_level
        FROM topic_prerequisites tp
        WHERE tp.subject = p_subject AND tp.topic = p_topic
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Recursive case: prerequisites of prerequisites
        SELECT 
            tp.prerequisite_topic AS prereq_topic,
            pt.depth_level + 1 AS depth_level
        FROM topic_prerequisites tp
        INNER JOIN prereq_tree pt ON tp.topic = pt.prereq_topic
        WHERE tp.subject = p_subject
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT prereq_topic, depth_level
    FROM prereq_tree
    ORDER BY depth_level DESC, prereq_topic;
END;

DECLARE
    v_prereq_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    -- Get prerequisites ordered by depth (deepest first)
    FOR v_prereq_record IN
        SELECT prerequisite_topic_name
        FROM get_prerequisite_chain(p_subject, p_topic)
        ORDER BY level DESC
    LOOP
        -- Check if this prerequisite is mastered
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts qa
            WHERE qa.user_id = p_user_id
                AND qa.subject = p_subject
                AND qa.topic ILIKE '%' || v_prereq_record.prerequisite_topic_name || '%'
                AND qa.score >= 70
        ) THEN
            RETURN v_prereq_record.prerequisite_topic_name;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
    
    RETURN NULL; -- All prerequisites mastered
END;

DECLARE
    v_exam_priority NUMERIC;
    v_knowledge_gap NUMERIC;
    v_emotion_modifier NUMERIC;
    v_composite_score NUMERIC;
    v_unmastered_prerequisite TEXT;
    v_current_theta NUMERIC;
    v_result JSON;
BEGIN
    -- Get current theta for difficulty adjustment
    SELECT COALESCE(theta, 0.0) INTO v_current_theta
    FROM quiz_attempts
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND subject = p_subject
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1;
    
    -- 1. Get exam priority score (weight: 0.4)
    SELECT COALESCE(probability, 0.5) INTO v_exam_priority
    FROM exam_predictions
    WHERE subject = p_subject AND topic = p_target_topic
    LIMIT 1;
    
    -- 2. Get knowledge gap score (weight: 0.4)
    v_knowledge_gap := get_knowledge_gap_score(p_user_id, p_subject, p_target_topic);
    
    -- 3. Get emotion modifier (weight: 0.2)
    v_emotion_modifier := CASE p_emotion_state
        WHEN 'frustrated' THEN -0.3
        WHEN 'fatigued' THEN -0.2
        ELSE 0.0
    END;
    
    -- 4. Calculate composite score
    v_composite_score := (v_exam_priority * 0.4) + (v_knowledge_gap * 0.4) + (v_emotion_modifier * 0.2);
    
    -- 5. Prerequisite gate check (if less than 50% prerequisites mastered)
    IF v_knowledge_gap <= 0.5 THEN
        v_unmastered_prerequisite := get_first_unmastered_prerequisite(p_user_id, p_subject, p_target_topic);
        
        v_result := json_build_object(
            'action', 'fill_prerequisite',
            'redirect_to', COALESCE(v_unmastered_prerequisite, p_target_topic),
            'reason', format('Only %s%% of prerequisites mastered for %s', 
                           ROUND(v_knowledge_gap * 100, 0), p_target_topic),
            'composite_score', ROUND(v_composite_score, 3),
            'exam_priority', ROUND(v_exam_priority, 3),
            'knowledge_gap', ROUND(v_knowledge_gap, 3),
            'emotion_modifier', v_emotion_modifier,
            'current_theta', ROUND(v_current_theta, 2),
            'recommended_difficulty', 
                CASE WHEN v_current_theta < -1.0 THEN 'easy'
                     WHEN v_current_theta < 1.0 THEN 'medium'
                     ELSE 'hard'
                END,
            'emotion_state', p_emotion_state
        );
        
        RETURN v_result;
    END IF;
    
    -- 6. Proceed to topic
    v_result := json_build_object(
        'action', 'proceed',
        'composite_score', ROUND(v_composite_score, 3),
        'exam_priority', ROUND(v_exam_priority, 3),
        'knowledge_gap', ROUND(v_knowledge_gap, 3),
        'emotion_modifier', v_emotion_modifier,
        'current_theta', ROUND(v_current_theta, 2),
        'recommended_difficulty', 
            CASE WHEN v_current_theta < -1.0 THEN 'easy'
                 WHEN v_current_theta < 1.0 THEN 'medium'
                 ELSE 'hard'
            END,
        'emotion_state', p_emotion_state,
        'encouragement_message', 
            CASE 
                WHEN p_emotion_state = 'frustrated' THEN '😊 চিন্তা করো না! তুমি পারবে! চলো আবার চেষ্টা করি! 💪'
                WHEN p_emotion_state = 'fatigued' THEN '😴 একটু বিরতি নাও, তারপর আবার শুরু করো! 🌟'
                ELSE '🚀 তুমি প্রস্তুত! চলো শুরু করি!'
            END
    );
    
    RETURN v_result;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT cc.id, cc.chunk_id, cc.content, cc.chunk_index, cc.metadata,
           1 - (cc.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
    FROM curriculum_chunks cc
    WHERE cc.embedding IS NOT NULL
      AND 1 - (cc.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
    ORDER BY cc.embedding <=> query_embedding
    LIMIT match_count;
